title.narrative: Scaling Up the Tiko Ecosystem for Youth Health and Employability in Ethiopia

description.narrative:
Strengthening the ecosystem value proposition for labor market actors (job trainers, employers and training service providers) so that they actively recruit and promote on the platform; improving the quality of training offerings on the platform by ensuring that training offerings reflect employer demand and needs; and improving the user journey to enable youth to connect with sector-specific employment and entrepreneurship opportunities.
On the demand-side, our approach is designed to reduce the cost to jobseekers for identifying training and employment opportunities appropriate to their goals and ambitions while also building their employability and motivation.

The goal of this component is to ensure that unemployed youth develop the employability skills and experience that they need to secure employment that they see as dignified and fulfilling. Our platform will bridge the gap between employer demand and young people’s skills and ambitions in order to significantly increase youth employability and linkages to employment.
Triggerise is targeting unemployed urban youth aged 15-24 who are not currently in employment in Addis Ababa and Bahir Dar.

organisation.narrative: Triggerise focus on activities on establishing strong project governance and partnerships, improving and diversifying platform offerings, strengthening the ecosystem value proposition to drive sustainability (user buy-in), ramping up diversified demand generation activities, and optimising the user journey to sustain end user engagement. This will enable Triggerise to quickly make program offering adjustments (especially regarding training quality). Triggerise intend to immediately begin leveraging the platform to link young people to employment, but we will also use this time period to optimise the platform offerings to respond to employer demand, ensuring value for money from the platform over the life of the project.

recipient-country.narrative: This activity is set to operate in Addis Ababa, the capital city of Ethiopia. It is expected to cover 6 sub-cities in the first year, and 8 sub-cities in the second year.

name.narrative: The implementation of the project is in Addis Ababa and Bahir dar
